title: Sodda kasrlarga ajratib integrallash: 2-to‘plam (15 savol)
description: Barcha integrallarda surat 1: maxrajni ajratish, sodda kasrlar, koeffitsiyentlar va to‘liq javob. 1–5 oson, 6–10 o‘rtacha, 11–15 murakkab. Har savolda 4 variant va izoh.

questions.explanation: {1|x^3 − 1} = {1/3|x − 1} − {x + 2|3(x^2 + x + 1)}. x + 2 = {1|2}(2x + 1) + {3|2}: birinchi qism ln ga, ikkinchisi to‘liq kvadrat (x + {1|2})^2 + {3|4} orqali arctg ga olib keladi.

questions.text:
∫ {dx|(x^3 + 8)(x + 1)}
Javobdagi ln∣x + 2∣ oldidagi koeffitsiyent nechaga teng?

∫ {dx|(x^3 + 1)(x − 2)}
Javobdagi ln∣x − 2∣ oldidagi koeffitsiyent nechaga teng?
questions.explanation: x = 2 da qolgan ko‘paytuvchi: 2^3 + 1 = 9, demak koeffitsiyent {1|9}.

questions.text:
∫ {dx|(x^4 − 16)(x + 1)}
Javobdagi ln∣x + 1∣ oldidagi koeffitsiyent nechaga teng?

∫ {dx|(x^4 − 5x^2 + 4)(x + 2)}
Integral ostidagi kasr qanday sodda kasrlarga ajraladi?
questions.explanation: x^4 − 5x^2 + 4 = (x − 1)(x + 1)(x − 2)(x + 2), yana (x + 2) bor — demak (x + 2)^2. Ikki karrali ko‘paytuvchi uchun {D|x + 2} va {E|(x + 2)^2} ikkalasi ham yoziladi.
a^5 + b^5 = (a + b)(a^4 − a^3b + a^2b^2 − ab^3 + b^4), bu yerda a = x, b = 2: x^4 − 2x^3 + 4x^2 − 8x + 16. Ishoralar almashinib keladi.

questions.text:
∫ {dx|(x^3 − 8)(x^2 − 1)}
Javobdagi ln∣x − 2∣ oldidagi koeffitsiyent nechaga teng?

∫ {dx|(x^4 − 1)(x^2 + 1)}
Integral ostidagi kasr qanday sodda kasrlarga ajraladi?
questions.explanation: x^4 − 1 = (x − 1)(x + 1)(x^2 + 1), yana (x^2 + 1) — demak (x^2 + 1)^2. Takrorlangan kvadrat ko‘paytuvchi uchun {Cx + D|x^2 + 1} va {Ex + F|(x^2 + 1)^2} ikkalasi kerak.

questions.text:
∫ {dx|(x^5 + 1)(x^2 − 4)}
Javobdagi ln∣x − 2∣ oldidagi koeffitsiyent nechaga teng?

∫ {dx|(x^6 − 64)(x + 2)}
Javobdagi ln∣x − 2∣ oldidagi koeffitsiyent nechaga teng?
questions.explanation: x^6 − 64 = (x − 2)(x^2 + 2x + 4)(x + 2)(x^2 − 2x + 4). x = 2 da qolganlari: 12·4·4·4 = 768 (bitta 4 — qo‘shimcha x + 2 dan), demak {1|768}.
